integrity: The universal claim is proved analytically by strict height monotonicity, exact boundary reduction, and one-variable derivative factorizations. Numerical root values are supplemental and reproduced by the bundled checker. The primary full text and materially relevant literature were inspected; a residual risk remains for unindexed or differently phrased prior work, and the full Ding–Fay text was not inspected. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem resolves the surface-area ratios only for Finch's canonical split. It does not address mean width, arbitrary splitting planes, or noncircular bases. The sharp values are infima approached as \(b\to0^+\), not minima attained by a nondegenerate cone.
title: Global surface-ratio minima for bisected oblique circular cones
